description: Time picker wrapping TmTimeInput with label, placeholder, clear button, and validation styling for out-of-range values. Additive Presentation keeps today's segments DOM by default; Popup/Auto compose TmTimeSelector into a TmOverlayPanel dialog (sheet on a mobile viewport).

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The bound time of day.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the committed time changes (live, or on Done in OnConfirm).

parameters.name: ValueExpression
parameters.description: Expression identifying the bound model field. Blazor supplies it automatically with @bind-Value; it links the nested input/selector to EditContext.NotifyFieldChanged.

parameters.name: MinTime
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound forwarded to the nested input/selector.

parameters.name: MaxTime
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound forwarded to the nested input/selector.

parameters.name: AllowOvernightRange
parameters.description: When true, MinTime after MaxTime is read as a range that crosses midnight. Forwarded to the nested TmTimeInput and TmTimeSelector. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: ShowSeconds
parameters.description: When true, a seconds segment / spinbutton is rendered. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder shown while Value is null.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables the nested input and the clock trigger. Distinct from ReadOnly.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the nested TmTimeInput read-only and blocks the overlay from opening (click/Enter/Space open nothing). Where the segments render (every layout except Auto on a phone) the overlay trigger is not rendered at all — the read-only segments carry the value and the lock (readonly + aria-readonly). On a phone (Auto) the trigger stays as the value's carrier: aria-disabled="true" with aria-haspopup="false", no aria-expanded/aria-controls and no opening icon (aria-readonly is not a supported attribute on role=button); it keeps its tab stop and AriaDescribedBy reaches it, so a host can describe WHY the field is locked. Root carries tm-time-picker--readonly so the locked trigger surface reads like the other read-only inputs (--tm-bg-surface-secondary, no disabled colours, no fade). Never assigned inside the picker. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: HourCycle
parameters.description: 12-hour versus 24-hour clock forwarded to TmTimeInput / TmTimeSelector. Default Auto follows Culture.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve HourCycle.Auto. Null uses CurrentCulture.

parameters.name: Required
parameters.description: Marks the label as required. Does not hide the clear button.

parameters.name: HideClear
parameters.description: Hides the clear button that is otherwise rendered while a Value is set and the picker is not Disabled. Defaults to false. Required does not hide the button implicitly.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Visible label. Also names the overlay dialog when SheetTitle is unset.

parameters.name: LabelTrailing
parameters.description: Content rendered at the END of the label row. Rendered only while set; without it the label markup is unchanged.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

parameters.name: Presentation
parameters.description: How the picker presents. Default Segments keeps today's TmTimeInput DOM with no overlay. Popup adds a clock trigger that opens TmTimeSelector in a dialog. Auto is a trigger+sheet on a mobile viewport and Popup otherwise.

parameters.name: CommitMode
parameters.description: When the overlay writes ValueChanged. Default Auto: a sheet holds a draft until Done; a popover commits live. OnConfirm always drafts (popover then renders its own Done). Close without Done discards the draft.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Layout used to resolve Auto presentation and forwarded to the overlay. Auto follows the viewport cascade; a forced value never measures.

parameters.name: SheetTitle
parameters.description: Visible title of the mobile sheet header. Falls back to Label, then the localized TmTimePicker_SheetTitle.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Stable id of the picker root. When set and InputId is unset, the hours segment uses {Id}-input.

parameters.name: InputId
parameters.description: Optional id applied to the hours segment so a parent label for can target it. Wins over the {Id}-input default. When both this and Id are unset the generated tm-time-picker-input-{guid} id is kept.

parameters.name: TriggerId
parameters.description: Optional explicit id for the clock trigger so a parent label for can target it when Auto on mobile hides the segments. Defaults to the generated tm-time-picker-trigger-{guid} id.

parameters.name: AriaDescribedBy
parameters.description: Extra ids referenced from every segment / spinbutton aria-describedby. Forwarded to the nested input and selector, and rendered on the overlay trigger as well — so the description reaches the locked phone trigger too. The trigger additionally joins the surrounding TmFormField cascade (error, then help) through TmDescribedBy.Join: on a phone (Auto) the trigger is the only focusable carrier of the value, so it reads the field-level help/error. The joined value is never forwarded INTO the nested input/selector (they consume the cascade themselves), so an id never doubles. Null (attribute omitted) outside a TmFormField with no AriaDescribedBy.

parameters.name: AriaLabelledBy
parameters.description: Optional id(s) that name the picker group and overlay. Wins over the visible Label for aria-labelledby. Used by TmTimeRangePicker so each end is named by its From/To group without setting Label.

parameters.name: MinuteStep
parameters.description: Minute step forwarded to the overlay selector. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: EnableSwipe
parameters.description: Forwards TmTimeSelector.EnableSwipe when Presentation is Popup or Auto. Default false keeps today's overlay (no swipe attribute, no pointer-drag on the spinbuttons).

parameters.name: EnforceStep
parameters.description: When true, an off-step bound value is marked invalid and never rewritten (forwarded to the overlay selector). Defaults to false.

parameters.name: ReferenceDate
parameters.description: Date used with TimeZone for DST gap/ambiguity. Both must be set.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: Time zone used with ReferenceDate for DST gap/ambiguity. Both must be set.

parameters.name: AmbiguousTimeResolution
parameters.description: Which occurrence of an ambiguous civil time to prefer. Defaults to earlier.

parameters.name: AmbiguousOffsetChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the chosen offset when the user resolves an ambiguous time in the overlay.

examples.title: Time picker with seconds and constraints
examples.code:
<TmTimePicker @bind-Value="selectedTime"
              Label="Alarm"
              ShowSeconds="true"
              MinTime="@(new TimeOnly(6, 0))"
              MaxTime="@(new TimeOnly(22, 0))" />
